summary: A generative chiptune firmware in the style of the Mega Drive: an emulated YM2612 and Sega-style PSG play seeded backing music that you shape with knobs and play along to on the keys.
features: Five YM2612 FM voices, DAC percussion, three PSG tones and noise
Endless generation or an 88-bar intro-to-outro song mode
Knobs for tempo, density, mutation and transpose; REC picks a new seed
Level plus decay, color and echo for each of twelve sources
USB/TRS MIDI in with clock follow; USB MIDI out on separate channels
Stereo USB audio of the mix; no browser editor, no preset import

headings: k1–k4 while playing: targeted physical test
provision the ignored .runtime dependencies first; see building.md.
